Think Technology # Background

This draft guide has been prepared to help clients to understand the assessment process in regard to fire-safety in residential buildings.

Collins Engineering is a multidisciplinary engineering consultancy providing technical expertise in the investigation of building fire safety. Collins Engineering’s fire engineers including the author, John Collins are fellows of the Chartered Institute of Fire and Safety Engineering and are registered with the Construction Industry Council under the Registered Professionals Scheme.

This publication may be freely adapted to meet the individual projects local requirements.

# Disclaimer

This is a draft guide for inspection reports in regard to building failure to comply with firesafety requirements of either A/SBD/14-01 or BS 9999. The guidance is based on extensive experience effective in communicating
